en.headline: Ancient Egypt Unveiled exhibition enters final weeks at Hong Kong Palace Museum
en.dek: The nine-and-a-half-month display of 250 treasures from Egyptian museums runs until 31 August, with extended evening hours and a special after-hours programme later this month.
body: The Hong Kong Palace Museum’s landmark exhibition Ancient Egypt Unveiled: Treasures from Egyptian Museums has entered its final weeks, closing on 31 August after nearly ten months on display.

Organised with the Supreme Council of Antiquities of Egypt, the show brings together 250 artefacts from seven leading Egyptian museums, many shown outside the country for the first time. The four thematic sections cover sacred kingship, religious beliefs, funerary traditions, daily life and cultural exchanges with neighbouring civilisations.

Throughout August the museum has extended opening hours, remaining open until 6 p.m. on Mondays to Thursdays and 8 p.m. on Fridays to Sundays. A special after-hours event titled A Pharaoh’s Rendezvous is scheduled for 19 August, offering exclusive gallery access, cultural talks, live music and dance, themed refreshments and a complimentary blind-box gift.

Special exhibition tickets are priced at HK$190 for adults and HK$95 for concessions. Full-access tickets covering other thematic exhibitions cost HK$230 and HK$115 respectively. The museum is located in the West Kowloon Cultural District.

zh.headline: 故宮博物館古埃及展進入最後數周 至8月31日結束
zh.dek: 展出250件埃及博物館珍品的大型展覽將於8月31日閉幕，本月延長開放時間，並於19日設特別夜間活動。
body: 香港故宮文化博物館大型展覽「古埃及文明大展：法老・神祇・木乃伊」已進入最後數周，將於8月31日結束，展期接近十個月。
展覽由香港故宮文化博物館與埃及最高文物委員會合辦，展出七家主要埃及博物館的250件文物，當中不少為首次於境外展出。展覽分為四個主題單元，涵蓋神聖王權、宗教信仰、喪葬傳統、日常生活，以及與鄰近文明的文化交流。
博物館於8月延長開放時間，周一至周四至下午6時，周五至周日至晚上8時。8月19日將舉行特別夜間活動「法老之約」，提供獨家展廳參觀、文化講座、現場音樂及舞蹈、主題飲食，以及附送盲盒禮物。
特別展覽門票成人190元、優惠票95元；全館通行證（包括其他專題展覽）分別為230元及115元。博物館位於西九文化區。
